hook.name: useShareController
hook.description: Provides screen-sharing status and actions for custom controls or keyboard shortcuts.

actions.name: toggleShare
actions.description: Starts screen sharing and labels annotations with the name of the person who drew them. Call it when you are not sharing; to stop sharing, call stopShare. If starting fails, an error notification appears, for example when the host has locked sharing or another participant is already sharing.

actions.name: stopShare
actions.description: Stops your screen share. No effect when you are not sharing.

actions.name: pauseShare
actions.description: Pauses your screen share. No effect when you are not sharing or the share is already paused.

actions.name: resumeShare
actions.description: Resumes your paused screen share. No effect when you are not sharing or the share is not paused.

actions.name: changeSharePrivilege
actions.description: Changes who can share. No effect unless canChangeSharePrivilege is true.

actions.name: toggleOptimizeForSharedVideo
actions.description: Turns optimization for shared video on or off, based on isEnableOptimizeForSharedVideo. No effect when you are not sharing or isSupportOptimizedForSharedVideo is false.

notes: Actions do nothing when the Video SDK client has no media stream. Unlike ShareButton, they don't check the connection state or whether the device is a phone or tablet.
Actions never reject. Only a failed start shows an error notification; other failures are not reported.

fields.name: isSharing
fields.description: True when the local user is currently sharing.

fields.name: sharePrivilege
fields.description: Who may share in this session. Starts as MultipleShare and updates when the host changes it.

fields.name: canChangeSharePrivilege
fields.description: Whether the current user is a host or co-host/manager.

fields.name: isSharingPaused
fields.description: True when the local user's active share is paused.

fields.name: isSupportOptimizedForSharedVideo
fields.description: True when the current browser or platform supports optimizing a screen share for video playback.

fields.name: isEnableOptimizeForSharedVideo
fields.description: True after toggleOptimizeForSharedVideo turns optimization on. Resets to false when your share ends. Not updated by the optimizedForSharedVideo start option or by direct Video SDK calls.

fields.name: toggleShare
fields.description: Starts the local screen share. To stop it, call stopShare.

fields.name: changeSharePrivilege
fields.description: Changes the session sharing privilege when the current user is a host or co-host/manager.

fields.name: toggleOptimizeForSharedVideo
fields.description: Turns optimization for shared video on or off.

types.name: SharePrivilege
types.description: Share privilege enum from the Zoom Video SDK. Import it with `import { SharePrivilege } from '@zoom/videosdk'`.

values.name: Unlocked
values.description: One participant can share at a time; only the host or a co-host can start sharing while someone else is sharing.

values.name: Locked
values.description: Only the host or a co-host can share.

types.name: ScreenShareOption
types.description: Screen share options from the Zoom Video SDK, accepted by toggleShare. Import the type with `import type { ScreenShareOption } from '@zoom/videosdk'`. Available options depend on your Video SDK version.
